title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Career Deep Dive
summary: Enjoy deeper immersion and more ways to play Manager and Player Career than ever before in EA SPORTS FC™ 27.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: Welcome to the EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Career Mode Deep Dive. The Career Mode team is thrilled to share all the new features and improvements coming to FC 27.

sections.title: Transfers
sections.summary: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 gives you one of the biggest Transfer Market upgrades in franchise history, with an overhaul that touches every part of the experience in Manager Career. From smarter AI decision-making to new negotiation features, fresh cutscenes, and a…

sections.title: Dynamic OVR
sections.summary: A player’s Overall Rating now reflects how they are actually performing this season, rather than feeling like a static measure of their ability. Dynamic OVR completely overhauls player ratings in FC 27 Career, turning OVR into a number that can rise and fall…

sections.title: Player Data
sections.summary: To further deepen authenticity around player development and replicate the variety of footballing career paths, we have introduced Growth Profiles, a new system determining player ability plateaus. Historically, player development followed a relatively…

sections.title: Creator Challenges
sections.summary: Manager Live Creator Challenges give you the tools to build, publish, and share your own Manager Career scenarios for the first time. Using the new Creator Portal, you can create Challenges from your phone, tablet, or computer, then publish them directly to…

sections.title: Discover Challenges
sections.summary: The Manager Live Hub has been expanded to support more EA-created and community-created Challenges. The number of available tabs has increased from 15 to 30, while the number of Challenges shown in each tab has increased from 5 to 20.

sections.title: Unexpected Events
sections.summary: Unexpected Events has been significantly expanded in EA SPORTS FC™ 27, introducing surprising player injuries and points deductions for financial mismanagement to bring a new layer of authenticity to your Career. These situations can also have meaningful…

sections.title: Practice Arena
sections.summary: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 introduces the Practice Arena into Career Mode, right from the Central Hub. Play 11v11 Practice Matches with your starting 11 against reserves and put your tactical setups and tweaks to the test.

sections.title: Fundamentals
subs: Existing Player Data for Generated Players
sections.summary: Deeper Simulation is expanding to include both previous season and current season performance. This means you’ll be able to compare form, evaluate consistency, and make more informed decisions across all Deeper Simulation leagues and associated cup…

sections.title: Player Career - Rivalries
sections.summary: In Player Career, your performances will be measured against AI players. Fans will set you up for Rivalries against others, setting performance-based Objectives to be met.

sections.title: Authentic Gameplay 2.0
